text:
marta: Heads-up — got a customer ping that they didn't get paged for a P1 last night. Checking incident channel and the incident-bot thread shows the alert was generated but no page went out. anyone oncall who can look?

song: I'm seeing the alert in our internal logs, but pagerduty shows the event was *suppressed*. looks like recent filter rules may be too greedy. digging. :mag:

alex: which filter? the paging rules were updated in the notify service yesterday. i deployed a tiny change to the filter regex to ignore noise from staging. could be that. commit `a3f9c4d`?

marta: yep that matches the window. timestamped ~01:10 UTC. customer impact — they had an unacked P1 for ~14m before noticing. can we escalate while we debug?

incident-bot: Automations: no pages sent for alert ID `alert-2026-03-22-9283`. Suppression matched rule `suppress:env:staging|staging-.*`. No manual overrides detected.

song: here's the filter regex from prod config (copied from running container):
```
# notify/filter_rules.conf
- name: suppress_env
  match: '\b(env|environment)\s*[:=]\s*(?:staging|stg|staging-\w+)\b'
  action: suppress
```

song: but incoming alert payload had `env: prod-us-west` and a new case-insensitive change in the regex engine caused `prod-us-west` to match because of a missing anchor. looks like `staging-\w+` collapsed to `-\w+` after our escaping change.

priya: ugh. I remember we changed the parser library version in the notify service image. that could alter how `\b` behaves in some embeddings. rolling back parser patch is an option.

alex: quick mitigation: disable the suppress rule to restore pages. i can revert the rule in config and push a hotfix to canary then prod. need a YES from oncall.

marta: go for it. i'll notify the customer and kick manual paging if anything else pops up.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by alex: `notify-service` hotfix v2.1.9-hotfix. Health checks OK on canary.

song: after reverting the rule on canary i triggered a synthetic alert and confirmed pages fire normally. pushing to prod now.

deploy-bot: Deploy successful to prod (2/2). Pages restored.

priya: done a quick postmortem checklist:
- revert filter change (done)
- pin parser lib version to previous working release
- add unit test for regex edgecases
- audit other suppression rules for ambiguous anchors

marta: customer notified: apologized, explained root cause (filter regression after parser bump), confirm pages are restored, offered 2hr post-incident review. they accepted.

alex: created ticket INF-4821 with remediation steps and the commit that introduced the change: `a3f9c4d`. assigning to eng-notify + eng-ml for parser compatibility review.

song: follow-up: add a monitor that checks recent P1 alerts vs pages sent. alert on mismatch for >2m. will open PR.

priya: also recommend a short-term guard: disallow suppress rules that match on `prod`-prefixed tokens without explicit negative lookahead.

marta: thanks team. main action items: 1) INF-4821 ownership, 2) PR for monitor, 3) parser pin and tests. i'll run postmortem doc and drop it in #postmortems. closing thread once actions are tracked. :white_check_mark:
